claims.text: Unconditional entry-only chunk-parallel routing is refuted by intra-chunk content dependencies; this is mechanism-specific, not a general parallel-computation lower bound.
X34 total parameter discrepancy is 0.001127%; trainable counts differ.
X34 final training-loss edge does not establish a held-out advantage: baseline final validation PPL is slightly lower.
X34 natural-text lane is active, occupancy scales linearly through T4096; both arms show zero-shot depth null.
B8/B64 confound corrected by protocol-matched B64 family control; X39 comparator ledger originally lacked completed d, so d must be recomputed from terminal receipt.
X37 b/c return to 16/16 identical peaks; policy hierarchy d has 0/16 and best family perplexity, with learned W_in and unequal-initial-head caveats.
X38 read anticorrelation is not complementary-slot specialization; monotonicity failed and quality cost depends on the comparator.
X39 four-lever results are finite-window occupancy/quality screens, not asymptotic information-content measurements.
Append-amplitude gradient does not differentiate hard allocation; semantic keys alone do not deduplicate; match wire plus semantic keys suffices in constructed circuits.
Semantic trained arm has targeted replay parity but source provenance, single-seed and retained-information limitations remain.
